mainEntity.name: How much does a piano weigh?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weight is the first fact the plan is built on, and an individual piano can run 100 lbs or more either side of its type's typical range, so the survey establishes the individual piece. Typical ranges: spinet 200 to 400 lbs; console 350 to 500 lbs; studio upright 400 to 600 lbs; full-size upright 500 to 800 lbs; baby grand 500 to 800 lbs; medium grand 700 to 900 lbs; concert grand 900 to 1,300 lbs.

mainEntity.name: Why does a grand piano move differently from an upright?

acceptedAnswer.text: An upright is a box: it is secured — fallboard and lid closed and locked or taped — and moved on a piano dolly or skid. A grand is a shape: the lid is secured, the legs and pedal lyre are removed and wrapped separately, and the body is turned onto its long straight side and strapped to a padded skid board before it moves. That dismantling and reassembly, a longer body to steer, and usually more weight are the difference.

mainEntity.name: How do stairs and floors change a piano move?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a staircase the weight is carried, not rolled, and a turn on a landing is the tightest geometry in the move — count the flights, the turns and the narrowest point at both addresses before anyone quotes you. The floors take the same weight standing still, concentrated onto small caster or leg contact points at both homes. Most pianos weigh well under the SIR band and move as white-glove pieces under the same piece-by-piece assessment — weight, fragile points, finish, value at risk.

mainEntity.name: Will a piano need tuning after the move?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, yes — but not because the ride shook it loose. Piano Technicians Guild guidance is that it is the climate change around a move — the new room's temperature and humidity reshaping the soundboard — that drifts the tuning, not the motion itself. Let the instrument settle into its new environment for a week or two, then have it tuned. Tuning is a technician's work, not a mover's: we move pianos; we do not tune them, and no tuning arrangement is part of our service.

mainEntity.name: When does a piece get a custom crate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protection is matched to the piece. Furniture and pieces travel fully covered in padded moving blankets and sealed with stretch wrap; a piece that needs more — because of its structure, its journey, or its value — gets a custom crate built around it.
